modules.module_title: Prepare the pond

pcs.pc_description: co-ordinate with an authorised lab to test the level of organic matters and pH in the soil
apply basal manure, lime, gypsum or any other necessary soil treatment in the recommended quantity to improve the soil fertility as advised by the lab
carry out de-mudding in the pond
drain out and sun-dry the perennial pond
construct dykes of recommended height at the pond
install inlet and outlet pipes in the pond for the efficient entry and exit of water
remove aquatic weed from the pond

modules.module_title: Set up the tank

pcs.pc_description: select an appropriate type of tank such as Fibre-Reinforced Plastic (FRP), Silpaulin tank, Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) tank according to the species and quantity of fish to be cultured
co-ordinate with an expert for the fabrication and installation of the tank
install air pumps, aerator and filters in the tank
install re-circulatory systems (RAS) as planned
fill the tank and pond with aged freshwater or seawater depending on the species to be cultured
apply net cover on the tanks to protect the fish from predatory birds and other external threats

modules.module_title: Select ornamental fish and assess their feed requirements

pcs.pc_description: select suitable species of ornamental fish to be cultured based on the water quality
identify the nutritional and feed requirements of selected species of fish
determine the feeding schedule for different stages of growth of the selected species

modules.module_title: Procure the ingredients for preparing feed and culturing live feed

pcs.pc_description: select various ingredients based on the nutritional requirement of the selected species
identify the relevant vendors to procure the ingredients for feed and culturing live feed
procure the ingredients in the required quantity
store the ingredients at the recommended temperature and humidity to preserve their quality
maintain the record of purchase manually and/ or electronically

modules.module_title: Culture live feed

pcs.pc_description: stock the procured material in the culture pond to culture live feed
culture live feed following the recommended method
maintain the hygiene and quality of live feed

modules.module_title: Procure and stock the ornamental fish seed

pcs.pc_description: procure healthy seeds of the selected ornamental fish species in the required quantity
stock the seeds in the culture pond maintaining the recommended stocking density
follow the recommended prophylaxis measures to prevent disease and outbreak of harmful organisms in the tank

modules.module_title: Carry out feeding and health management

pcs.pc_description: feed the stocked seeds with the required nutrients as per the recommended feeding schedule
apply necessary changes to feed according to the stages of fish’s growth
identify the signs of stress and disease in the fish
select an appropriate treatment or consult an expert
apply the prescribed treatment in the recommended quantity

modules.module_title: Manage the water quality

pcs.pc_description: maintain optimum pond temperature according to the season to avoid stress to the fish
check that the optimum level of dissolved oxygen is present in the pond water
maintain the recommended levels of salinity and alkalinity according to the cultured fish species
carry out aeration using aerators
maintain optimum depth and stocking density for the cultured species
remove the decomposing organic waste material from the pond to maintain the pH levels
check the quality of water regularly against the relevant quality parameters

modules.module_title: Carry out fish breeding

pcs.pc_description: arrange for periodic exchange of water
undertake broodstock development
carry out breeding in the culture pond following the recommended method
stock fish in the tank when they attain the recommended growth
rear fish in the tank to a marketable size

modules.module_title: Harvest, condition and pack the fish

pcs.pc_description: check the fish to ensure it has achieved the maturity required for harvesting
carry out prophylactic nutrition and reduce the water level in the pond before harvesting
harvest the fish using appropriate tools and equipment, ensuring no damage to the fish
store the harvested fish at the recommended temperature and humidity
condition and starve the fish before packing
pack the fish in appropriate containers/aerated polythene packs maintaining the recommended density
protect the fish from contamination while being harvested and packed

modules.module_title: Market the harvested fish

pcs.pc_description: identify the potential buyers of the harvested ornamental fish
negotiate the price with the selected buyer(s)
transport the fish to the buyer in the ordered quantity
process payments using the buyer- preferred e-payment method
maintain the record of sales and payments manually and/ or electronically

modules.module_title: Optimise resource utilisation

pcs.pc_description: optimise the usage of water and other resources in various tasks and processes
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage

modules.module_title: Perform waste management

pcs.pc_description: treat the wastewater for recycling by applying lime or the approved disinfectant(s)
check the quality parameters of the treated water for its suitability for re-use
utilise the recycled water for culture operations
segregate waste into appropriate categories
dispose the non-recyclable waste in an environment-friendly manner and recycle the recyclable waste appropriately

modules.module_title: Maintain the water body and its hygiene

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended practices to protect the aquaculture farm from different types of threats such as storms, predatory birds, harmful organisms, poachers, etc.
carry out regular maintenance of the dykes and fences in the culture pond
identify and remove the preying organisms from the culture pond or tank
remove sludge, algae, uneaten feed and any other waste materials from the culture pond or tank
apply the necessary disinfectants or preventive treatment in the culture pond or tank to prevent disease outbreak and the growth of harmful organisms

modules.module_title: Maintain the health of cultured organisms

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended practices to protect the cultured organisms from the air, water or fomite-borne contamination and diseases
sample the cultured organisms regularly to identify the signs of stress/ disease/ phenotypic disorders and the presence of parasites and pathogens
identify, quarantine and treat the unhealthy organisms following the recommended practices
monitor the quarantined organisms for signs of improvement and restock them in the culture pond or tank on complete recovery
remove the dead and moribund organisms and dispose them in an environment-friendly manner

modules.module_title: Maintain personal health and safety

pcs.pc_description: check the relevant Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) before use and repair or replace it, as required
use the relevant PPE during various aquaculture operations such as the application of hazardous chemicals
use the recommended soap or sanitiser to keep hands sanitised
store hazardous chemicals, tools and equipment in the safe storage area to avoid personal harm or injury
administer first-aid to the injured personnel and co-ordinate with the emergency services for further medical attention

modules.module_title: Set up the marine/ freshwater aquarium

pcs.pc_description: arrange the necessary resources to set up the marine/ freshwater aquarium such as aquarium tank, air pump, protein skimmer, heater and thermometer, etc.
arrange aerators, filters and other aquarium accessories like stone, weeds, substratum etc
sanitise and acclimatise the relevant items before setting up in the aquarium to avoid contamination
set up the aquarium structure by assembling and installing the required components such as reef, rocks, pebbles, etc.
install timers to automate the functioning of lights, filtration pumps and heating system
follow the safety guidelines in setting up the marine and freshwater aquariums including electrical connections

modules.module_title: Stock and feed the fish

pcs.pc_description: fill in the aquarium with the recommended quantity of treated water for the selected species
stock the selected varieties of aquarium fish maintaining the recommended stocking density
acclimatise the fish before stocking in the aquarium and take appropriate measures to protect them from new tank syndrome
feed the aquarium fish with nutritionally- balanced feed in the recommended quantity as per the feeding schedule

modules.module_title: Maintain the aquarium and water quality

pcs.pc_description: maintain the recommended percentage and frequency of water exchange/ replacement in the aquarium
stock organisms in the aquarium that help in cleaning the reef system by consuming ectoparasites and feed residues
carry out regular sampling of the water to ensure the recommended levels of pH, ammonia, nitrite and salinity
monitor the reef system in the aquarium for parasites and any undesirable growth that may threaten the balance of the reef system
check the protein skimmers and filtration equipment for correct functioning to ensure efficient removal of waste matters and optimum water quality in the aquarium
carry out regular cleaning of the aquarium to remove feed residue and any waste materials

modules.module_title: Carry out health and disease management

pcs.pc_description: identify the symptoms of stress and common diseases among the aquarium fish
identify and quarantine the diseased or dying fish
treat the quarantined fish with the prescribed treatment
monitor the quarantined fish for signs of improvement and restock them with the aquarium fish once cured
